chart: accuracy and answer rate vs how much data is in the sample
evaluation: hold-out: the phase ranker, joint decoder and function model were retrained on 337 DEV signals and scored on the 38 signals of fold 0 (505 labelled detectors). The 43 TEST signals were not used.
sampling: 26 log-spaced durations from 1 min to 72 h, each measured from the SAME 10 anchor start times (nested windows; an anchor is moved earlier when the window would run past the end of the data), averaged over anchors.

minimum_evidence_rule.meaning: a detector with fewer than this many ON events in the sample gets no answer; predict.py reports 'not enough data' and keeps the raw opinion in phase_guess / function_guess

accuracy_definition: share of answered detectors whose predicted phase matches the label; answered detectors whose labelled phase never turns green in the window are left out (n_label_never_green)
smoothing: Monotone (isotonic, weighted by detectors scored) fit in log-minutes, then gaussian blur. Raw averages are in by_duration_raw.
